title: 6973GH-27-RFI-00001 - Ultralife UBBL13-01 Lithium-Ion Batteries - RFI
agency: TRANSPORTATION, DEPARTMENT OF > FEDERAL AVIATION ADMINISTRATION > 6973GH FRANCHISE ACQUISITION SVCS
description:
The Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) is issuing aRequest for Information (RFI) for “Storage, Conditioning,Quality Screening, Maintaining, Procurement, and Shipping Services for Ultralife UBBL13-01 Lithium-Ion Batteries.” Please see attached documents for detailed instructions. 

 THIS IS NOT A REQUEST FOR PROPOSALS OR OFFERS. ASIR/Request for Proposal may be issued under a separate announcement in the future. The FAA is not seekingor accepting unsolicited proposals. The FAA will not pay for any information received or costs incurred in preparing vendor responses to this market survey. Therefore, any cost associated with a market survey submission is solely at the interested vendor’s expense. 

 The purpose of this RFI is to solicit statements of interestand capabilities from large businesses, small businesses, service-disabled veteran-owned small businesses and 8(a) certified firms, capable of providing the services and products outlined in this document, in the timeframe stated inthis document. The responses to this RFI will help determine the acquisition strategy and whether adequate competition exists to set-aside the competition among small businesses, service-disabled veteran-owned small businesses or Socially & Economically Disadvantage Business(SEDB/8(a)) certified firms. 

 Below is a list of the requirements. 

 Please see attachments for specific information in addition to the Q&A attachment from the initial RFI posted October 29, 2026. 

   Items:   

 
	 Storage of Ultralife UBBL13-01 Batteries 
	 Conditioning of Ultralife UBBL13-01 Batteries 
	 Quality Screening of Ultralife UBBL13-01 Batteries 
	 Procurement of Ultralife UBBL13-01 Batteries 
	 Maintenance of Ultralife UBBL13-01 Batteries 
	 Shipment of Ultralife UBBL13-01 Batteries 
 

   ROM breakout (75-100 batteries):    

 
	 Warehousing/Storage 
	 Conditioning/Quality Screening/Maintaining 
	 Procurement 
	 Shipping 
	 Reporting (only required for first QTY. 100 batteries provided by FAA) 
	 Initial procurement of equipment necessary to maintain batteries. 
 

  

 The FAA seeks statements of interest and capabilities from vendors capable of performing the services described in the attached draft Statement of Objective (SOO). Industry feed-back regarding the Government’s approach is encouraged. 

 Responses will be used to assess market capability and determine the appropriate acquisition strategy, including the potential for small business, Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business (SDVOSB), or SBA 8(a) set-asides. 
NAICS Code: 493110 General Warehousing and Storage 

 If applicable, respondents shall provide a copy of their SBA8(a) certification letter. 

   Interested Vendors Submission Requirements:   

 
	 Capability Statement, including:
	 
		 Experience in storing, conditioning, quality-screening, maintaining, procuring, and shipping Lithium-Ionrechargeable batteriess as identified in the draft SOO. 
		 Relevant contracts and past performance, includingcontract values, quantities, and customer references. 
		 Previous Government contracts involving similarservices. 
		 Number of years in business. 
		 Description of the proposed execution approach, in-cluding the ability to perform services in accordancewith SOO requirements. 
		 ROM. 
	 
	 
 

 Response Due Date: Responses must be received no later than 4:00 PM Central Time (Oklahoma Time) on December 15, 2026. 

 Submit all responses electronically to: 
Email: tamara.m.maxwell@faa.gov 

 Please include the following in the subject line: 
 6973GH-27-RFI-00001 - Ultralife UBBL13-01 Lithium-IonBatteries - RFI Version II  

 Respondents should clearly mark any proprietary informa-tion as PROPRIETARY. Information submitted will be usedsolely for market research purposes.
